doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Defines the terms Contractor, Jemena, Others, Package(s), Proposal, Requisition, Specification, and Works/the Work as used in this Specification.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: This Specification sets out the minimum technical and material requirements for the shop fabrication, welding, heat treatment, coating, examination, testing and cleaning of piping and mechanical equipment.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: This Specification is to be used in conjunction with AS 4041 where specified.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Materials are to be in accordance with AS 4041 or AS 2885 as specified.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Exceptions to this Specification are to be requested via the Technical Query form in Appendix A.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Defines the abbreviations AGA, API, AS, ASME, DN, DNC, DPI, FAT, FCAW, FFW, kPag, GMAW, GSFCAW, GTAW, IQI, ITP, MDR, MMAW, MPI, NATA, NDE, PWHT, P&ID, SAW, WPS, WPQR and WPRT.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Deviation of the Works is to be authorised in writing via the Technical Query (TQ) form.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: In the event of conflicting requirements, the order of precedence is: 1. Statutory Regulations/Acts; 2. Australian & International Codes and Standards; 3. this Fabrication Specification; 4. Datasheets and/or drawings.

rule_text: A Quality Plan is required.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: An approved project-specific ITP is referenced; the ITP is to cover all facets of the work and include hold points for major components.

rule_text: New materials are addressed under the quality assurance requirements.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Material control procedures are to be in place before work commences; traceable certification is to be retained in the MDR.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Material control covers receipt/verification; sub-contractor traceability; consumable traceability; handling; storage; marking/identification; quarantine; and a materials register subject to audit.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
clause_title: Marking, Identification and Traceability - General Requirements
rule_text: Marking and identification are to be in accordance with AS4458.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
clause_title: Marking, Identification and Traceability - General Requirements
rule_text: Unique spool numbers are to be assigned and recorded on the isometric.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
clause_title: Marking, Identification and Traceability - General Requirements
rule_text: Paint markers are to be free of sulphur, chlorides and halogens.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
clause_title: Marking, Identification and Traceability - General Requirements
rule_text: For PWHT, paint is to be less than 250ppm lead, zinc, tin, copper and titanium-oxide.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
clause_title: Marking, Identification and Traceability - General Requirements
rule_text: Offcut identification is to be transferred by metal disc stamping.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
clause_title: Marking, Identification and Traceability - General Requirements
rule_text: Unidentifiable material is to be rejected and markings maintained.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Markings are to be maintained and transferred to as-built records, verified by Jemena before covering.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: The traceability system is to locate an item together with its quality records, and the system is to be submitted for approval.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: As-built drawings are to be a red-line mark-up of P&IDs and Construction Isometrics, with no design changes; Jemena rejects as-builts containing design changes.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Materials are to be in accordance with AS4041 or AS 2885.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Materials are to be new, unused and defect-free.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Attachments are to be of the same material as the parent pipe unless Jemena approves otherwise.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Material is to be quarantined until identified; Mill Certificates are required.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Temporary materials, including hydrotest gaskets, are addressed.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: GMAW consumables are to comply with AWS A5.9 or A5.18.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: GSFCAW consumables are to comply with AWS A5.20.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: GTAW consumables are to comply with AWS A5.18.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: SAW Wire & Flux are to comply with AWS A5.17 or A5.23.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Shielding Gases are to be Jemena-approved.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: MMAW consumables are to comply with AWS A5.1 or A5.5.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: FCAW consumables are to comply with AWS A5.20 or A5.29.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Consumables are to be batch tested and supplied with certificates, in sealed factory packaging.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Weld-metal properties are to be similar to the base; the higher grade governs transition welds; impact test properties are to match.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Storage and handling procedures are to be in accordance with Section 11, with moisture/contamination control, segregated storage and the manufacturer's pre-dry instructions.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Fabrication is to conform to AS 4041.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Work is to be performed in an illuminated and ventilated workshop; dimensions are to be verified.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: On-site fabrication is to be minimised and confirmed with Jemena prior to award.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Each pipe is to be inspected for dirt, damage and coating defects.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Grooves, gouges and dents are to be repaired in accordance with AS4037, AS4458 and Section 7.4, with Jemena approval.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Field Fit Weld (FFW) provisions require Jemena approval, are to be minimised and identified on GA drawings.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Pipe is to be butt welded unless otherwise specified; welding is to be in accordance with Section 6.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Longitudinal seams are to be offset a minimum of 90° or 250 mm whichever is smaller.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: The minimum girth-weld distance is 1.5 x pipe diameter; approval is required if this is not met.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: The minimum branch-weld distance is 6 x wall thickness; closer if PWHT.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Branch and non-pressure welds are not to cross seams or butt welds, with toe-to-toe separation; avoid more than 2 weld intersections.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Branch connection type/size is to be per the branch chart; bore edges are to be radiused.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: DN 25 and below are to be drilled and de-burred.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Reinforcement pads are to have a ¼" NPT plugged hole.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Structural/trunnion pads are to have one 6mm vent hole sealed with mastic.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Proprietary bends/fittings are to be used; no cold bending is permitted for HP facility.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Dimensions and tolerances are to be in accordance with AS4041 or AS 2885.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Linear tolerance is ±1.5 mm for spools ≤1.5 m and ±3.0 mm for spools >1.5 m; closer tolerances may be specified; tolerances are not cumulative.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Angular tolerance is ±0.50°.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Flange bolt-hole misalignment is to be ≤1.5 mm and to straddle centre lines ±0.50°.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Flange face offset from square is to be ≤¼° or 1 mm whichever is smaller; mating flanges are to be parallel.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Threads are to be NPT unless otherwise specified, in accordance with ASME B1.20.1 and per the piping class data sheet.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: A proprietary lubricant is to be used; cut threads are to be protected.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: No worn or damaged dies are permitted.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Tapered safety cuts are to be made on plugs.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Threads are to be cut after heat treatment where possible, else chased/tapped after heat treatment.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: PWHT is required per AS 4458, the line spec or isometrics; stress-reduction PWHT requires Jemena approval.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: A written PWHT procedure and weld procedure are to be submitted for approval.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Sufficient thermocouples are to be used; machined surfaces are to be protected.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: No manual gas torches, gas rings or exothermic kits are permitted; rigid support and venting are required; PTFE pads are to be protected.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: PWHT Reports contents are specified; no welding or heating is permitted after final PWHT; NDE is to be performed after final PWHT.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Internal inspection and cleaning are required; installation is to be per drawings with no changes without Jemena written permission.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Work is to be neat and to good practice, true vertical/horizontal, avoiding residual stress with no springing, forcing, misalignment or cold pull.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Permanent supports are to be fitted where practicable; swab clean before tie-in; protect inline fittings and cover open ends.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Flanged connections are to be per the class datasheet with new gaskets/bolting and washers.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: A Bolt Torque & Tensioning Procedure per GAS-980-PR-ME-003 is to be submitted for approval.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Thread lubricant is to be used with uniform diametric tightening, flanges parallel, and ≥3 free threads per GAS-980-PR-ME-003.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Damaged gaskets are to be replaced at no cost; faces are to be clean/undamaged, parallel/centred, with no excessive force.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Spiral wound gaskets are to be to guide-ring thickness; no gasket re-use and no sealing compound.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: In-line valves are to be installed per drawings and operable, in accordance with GTS-960-SP-ME-010.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Operator positioning follows an order of preference; actuated valves are installed per the manufacturer.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Threaded connections are to be aligned with no projection interference; damaged threads are to be checked/cut; AGA-approved sealant/tape is to be used; no seal welding.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Supports are to be per project drawings with no welding except where shown.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Attachments are to be of parent material with non-penetrating welds by qualified welders; reinforcement pads are from header pipe; no load gaps.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Vibration supports are per detail; anti-friction pads are to be used.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: In-line instruments are not to be installed until flush/pressure test is complete; temporary spools are used.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Instrument tubing/fittings are to be per detail drawings.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: An approved cutter is to be used and the tube reamed; no hacksaw; approved bending machines; true vertical/horizontal; close ends; cable-tray routing with staggered joints.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Swagelok compression fittings are to be used with a gap gauge; AGA-approved thread sealant; discrepancies via TQ form; clean pneumatic tubing.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: A unique tag per P&ID is required; stainless steel ≥1mm, 3mm drilling, 10mm text etched black, with chamfered edges.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Open ends are to be plugged/capped at shift end; no tack welds; Contractor-furnished.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Internal cleaning is required during construction: lance with filtered compressed air; brush/swab each spool; de-burr welded joints; particular care at weld areas.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Welding is to be in accordance with AS4041, AS3992 and this specification; structural welding per AS1554.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Previously qualified procedures may be accepted; WPS/WPQR are to be submitted for approval; a repair-welding procedure is required.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Products are to be within manufacturer limits; Jemena may revoke.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Welds commenced the same day are to be completed the same day; WPS essential variables are per AS3992.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: For carbon steel DN 50 and below, GTAW is to be used for the first pass; remaining passes GTAW/MMAW/GMAW*/FCAW*/SAW, where * is after Jemena approval.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Alternatives are only permitted with Jemena approval and supporting evidence.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: A qualification plan is to be submitted; no qualification until the WPS is approved; qualify to AS3992/AS4041 and this specification.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: No repair of qualification welds is permitted; calibrated equipment with certificates reviewed; a qualified monitor; the Contractor is responsible for NDE/destructive testing per 6.3.2.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Test welds are to be cleared by NDE before mechanical testing unless Jemena approves otherwise; mechanical testing is per AS3992/AS4041.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Charpy of ASTM A106 Gr. B is tested at minimum design temperature, evaluated per AS4041; mechanical testing is by an independent NATA lab.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
clause_title: Inspection and NDE of Test Welds
rule_text: Test welds are to be inspected per AS4041 and this specification; when PWHT applies, final acceptance NDE is after PWHT.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: WPQR data, test results and the final WPS are to be submitted for approval; WPQR includes Charpy and mill certs.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Detailed WPSs for repair are required per material/thickness, with a defect removal method statement.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Repair WPS qualification is not required for carbon steel if the same WPS is used.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Only one repair per weld joint is permitted, else a new joint is required.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Pipe welds are to be qualified per AS3992/AS4041; an experienced certified welding supervisor is required per AS4041.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: ID numbers are to be recorded on the weld map; records are to be available.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Welder IDs are not to be re-assigned.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Production welding is to be per AS4458, approved procedures and approved welders.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Welds are to be protected from wind/rain; no backing rings; no lift until 50% weld depth; re-PWHT if welding after PWHT.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: O-let welds are to be a concave fillet with the toe ground smooth (see Appendix B); each pass is to be cleaned; no quenching; clean surfaces; FFW per 5.2; refrain in bad weather; no arc burns.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: ASTM A106 Gr. B Charpy per length is tested at minimum design temperature per AS4041, by an independent NATA lab, with results in the MDR.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Thermal-cut edges are to be ground; preheat before thermal cut/gouge; visual exam for laminations/cracks; weld bevels per WPS/AS4041; protect open pipework; clean internals before fit-up.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Line-up clamps/bridging are to be used with tacks in the bevel; no strong-backs; misalignment per AS4458; no temporary attachments.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Stainless tack bridging is to use the root-pass process/consumables.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: DN 80+ require a minimum of four 30 mm tacks equidistant; remove all tacks; bridge tacks; grind and NDE cracked tacks.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Adequate controls with calibrated meters; individual earthing; no floating/temporary earths; non-arcing ground clamps; consumable control per 4.2.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Welding is to be continuous except for de-slag/electrode change; indefinite interruption is permitted after root + first fill for DN150 and 15 mm wall and smaller, or where throat ≥15 mm with no preheat; re-inspect visual + MPI and re-establish preheat before resuming.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Preheat is required when the WPS requires it or when damp; minimum preheat is per the WPS, established 75 mm either side.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Temperature is measured on the opposite face or after waiting 1 min/25 mm; heaters are allowed; no cutting-torch preheat; maximum interpass is 300°C for carbon steels.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: GTAW shielding/purge is to be 99.9% argon, maintained until complete.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Socket welds are to be cut square and deburred, backed off 1.5 mm from the socket seat; radiography is optional; fillet pressure-containment welds are a minimum of two runs.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Arc strikes are to be avoided and removed by grinding + acid etch + MPI; remaining thickness is to be UT/depth-gauged to ≥ minimum design.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Golden weld location/number is per isometrics; changes need Jemena written approval; no golden welds on pipe-to-fitting or fitting-to-fitting; golden welds get complete DPT + complete MPT + 100% RT.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: An NDE Schedule is to be submitted for approval per AS4037 and/or AS 2885; free access is to be provided; 5 days notice before test; retest after repair at Contractor cost; a consumable storage/handling procedure is required.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: All preparation, fit-up and assemblies are to be inspected; quality is per AS4037/AS3992; cracks/undercut are rejection; cracked welds are cut out except crater cracks; cracks are reported and investigated; branch/pad welds merge smoothly (see Appendix B).

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: The Contractor provides equipment/services; all pressure welds are NDE per the project spec; acceptance is per AS4037 Very Harmful Gas fluid service; NDE is 100% unless specified otherwise, per AS4037.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Records are provided to Jemena; the NDE written practice is endorsed; licensed personnel acceptable to Jemena, a NATA-accredited company and NATA signatory are required.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Welds are sentenced C/DNC with a report; % welding and repair rate are tracked; for <100% NDE, equal coverage per welder/operator/procedure is required; X-Ray is required, Gamma case-by-case.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: 100% of the nominated weld length is radiographed; UT may be used instead if configuration precludes radiography and Jemena accepts.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: X-ray fine-grain film is to be used; x-ray is preferred for ≤25 mm wall, gamma case-by-case; radiographic procedures are to be developed.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: A source-side wire IQI per AS2177 is used; single wall single image; lead screens and fine-grain high-contrast film.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Minimum film density is 1.7 through the weld and parent 2.5–4.0 for x-ray; no fluorescent screens; sensitivity/unsharpness per AS4037.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Qualification radiographs are retained free of masking defects; lead-character ID content a–f; other NDE for clarification; a radiation safety officer, regulations and signage/barriers are required.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Archival film life is ≥7 years; manufacturer tests apply; store per NATA.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Ultrasonic examination is per AS4037; a procedure is submitted for approval; scan all surfaces; the probe is within ±10° of normal; critical root scan single-sided; full angle-probe range.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: A NATA report with technique/defects, sketches, defect-type identification and indication of incomplete coverage is required, to a minimum content list.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: MPI is per AS4037, in continuous mode, with two exams at right angles and 100% overlap; indications are ground and thickness checked.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: DPI is per AS4037, solvent removable unless requested; light dressing is allowed; indications are ground and thickness checked.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: An NDE test report per NATA and code is submitted to Jemena.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Acceptance criteria are per AS4037 Very Harmful Gas fluid service.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: DNC welds are repaired/replaced per an approved qualified procedure, with repeat NDE except for grinding-only.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Cracked/failed welds are cut out; the same NDE methods apply, with final NDE ≥24 hrs after repair.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: No more than two repairs per weld are permitted, else cut out/discard; a defect log is kept for trends.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Repaired welds are re-heat-treated if originally heat-treated; minimum remaining wall is ≥ minimum design including corrosion allowance.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Surface flaws are removed by gouging/grinding to a smooth transition and re-NDE'd; a repair is proposed if below minimum design.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Arc burns are ground + 10% ammonium persulphate etch + UT of remaining thickness; Jemena is notified with a witness option; arc burns/strikes on pressure-retaining components are to be avoided.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Pressure testing is witnessed by Jemena; hydrostatic test is 1.5 x design pressure; then drain/dry/pneumatic 1,000 kPag compressed nitrogen; 5 days notice.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: The hydrostatic test is a combined strength + leak test per AS4041 or AS 2885; test pressures are per isometrics.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Potable town water is used, with anti-corrosive additive if valves are present; indoors is preferred and a site hydrotest needs Jemena approval.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Hold for 1 hour with welds unpainted unless approved; if painted, hold ≥4 hours with a chart recorder.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Submit procedures/P&IDs/test package; use NATA-calibrated gauges/thermometers with electronic recording; remove/isolate low-range devices.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Remove control valves/instruments/regulators/tubing and install pups/blinds/plugs; procured equipment need not be hydrotested; manual blow-down/injection valves are hydro-tested ¾ open.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: No repairs after hydrotest without approval; identical gaskets/bolting to operating duty, replaced after; constant pressure with make-up measured/recorded; dry surface for leak ID; defects located/repaired/retested at Contractor cost.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Drain immediately; remove sections as needed; drain valve cavities and de-watering fluid.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Dry with warm dehydrated air at dewpoint -40°C; accept as dry when exit air dewpoint is -20°C for three successive 10-minute-interval measurements; Contractor equipment.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Nitrogen >99.9% is used to confirm socket-welded valves are gas tight, on assembled finished skids; socket-welded manual valves are tested closed; remove plugs; this is not for nitrogen injection; reinstate blind flanges.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Use zero-bubble leak detection fluid e.g. Snoop; introduce slowly to 1,000 kPag; hold for inspection; Jemena witnesses.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Document failures, await Jemena instruction, retest at Contractor cost if Contractor fault; remove films, reinstate plugs; valves returned full open and secured.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: External coating is per Jemena GTS-960-SP-ME-001; blast/prime after NDE; protect machined surfaces and check records.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Blasting is witnessed by Jemena; welded joints are left exposed until hydrotest per Section 8; a coating inspection report per AS2312 is kept in the MDR.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: The Contractor notifies completion after its own inspection, with 1 week notice.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Mechanical inspection checks: internal clean/dry; correct pressure rating/class per P&ID; tubing/fittings per 5.4.7; steel piping/components/valves/regulators/instruments/flow directions per P&ID; paint/galv thickness/condition/colour with no overspray; frame stable/level/supports; stainless tags per 5.4.8; bolting tightened per manufacturer/Standard/approved Bolt Torque & Tensioning Procedure; record template Appendix C.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Jemena records non-conformances and issues them to the Contractor; no time extension; Liquidated Damages apply.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Immediate rectification is required and recorded on the punchlist; authorise complete; forward to Jemena; Appendix D form.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: The MDR is submitted concurrent with the completion notice; Jemena reviews non-conformances; no time extension; Liquidated Damages apply.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Jemena approves the MDR when issues are resolved and confirms the FAT date.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Set points are checked for Run 1 & Run 2 per P&ID; the Contractor supplies nitrogen and blind flanges/gaskets; Jemena provides regulators/hoses; the skid is left at a positive 30 kPag nitrogen at completion; records on Appendix E.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Seal open ends with temporary blind flanges; seal-weld steel cape at pipe ends until tie-in; apply lubricant/grease on machined surfaces with temporary covers.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: A storage/handling procedure is submitted for approval to prevent mechanical/coating damage, weathering and theft.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Minimise pipe flex; no dropping/dragging/skidding; no metal bolsters/chain wrenches.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Valves are stored until spools are ready, preventing moisture ingress; globe/gate stored closed, ball/plug fully open; seal open ends.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Bolting is stored under cover with lubricant; mask stainless/nameplates/threads/machined surfaces, oil non-stainless; segregate grades.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Protect flanges/weld preps/threads; store uncoated flanges/gaskets/bolts indoors dry; use non-metallic or coated slings; damaged materials are replaced/repaired at Contractor cost.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Packing is for outdoor unprotected storage; a preservation/protection procedure is submitted for approval.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Transport the full skid with supports/base frame where possible, bolted down, with loose items secured; preserve during storage/fabrication/load-out; seal all openings; apply rust preventative on exposed machined surfaces; hard-stamp-tag loose flanges.

doc_title: Piping and Mechanical Equipment – Shop Fabrication Specification For Facilities
rule_text: Pack loose spools/valves/bolts/gaskets in boxes with no mixed metals per crate; loose valves per API 6D Section 8 additions: plug apertures/vents; no tack-welding protectors; moisture-resistant rigid crates with waterproof plastic envelope, marked per PO; hard-copy certification shipped with the equipment.
